newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma pierces 310, depos softer, bonds flat.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma pierces 310, depos softer, bonds flat.

text.p: The drachma was weaker against the ecu in late dealings, trading above 310, after a large local bank bought 100 million marks for drachmas at the fixing, dealers said.

"Ecu/drachma is trading above 310 in late dealings, around 310.15/20," said a forex dealer. "A large bank sold 100 million marks at the fixing which were provided for by other local banks, driving mark/drachma above 157."
The market sold the ecu/drachma cross at rates above 310.10 at the fixing and this could raise the support level for ecu/drachma above the previous 309.50, dealers said.
"I am sure that the central bank knew in advance that a large amount of marks would be bought at the fixing but it did not intervene," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank.
Depos eased a bit after the central bank added liquidity to the market via 5-day repo funds and forex forwards were trading also lower in late dealings.
The Bank of Greece injected 96.8 billion drachmas in five-day securities repurchase funds at 12.90 percent. It fully satisfied all bids.
Fixed coupon bonds were steading and FRNs were softer, bond dealers said.
The mark was quoted at 157.04/14 from Friday's 157.150 fix, the dollar at 282.55/65 drachmas from 281.600 and the ecu at 310.11/21 from 309.86 drachmas.
